description:
The multiplier lives in the last inch above the drain.

Brinkball is a one-thumb arcade score-attack. The ember ball is always falling; tap to swat it back up through fields of luminous glass orbs — it launches toward your tap, so you aim and fire in one touch. But here's the game: the strip at the bottom has three bands. Flip early from the blue band and every orb is worth ×1. Hold your nerve into the amber band for ×2. Let the ball plunge to the thin red strip just above the drain — the BRINK — and time slows, the screen flashes, and everything you pop is worth ×4. The optimal play is always the terrifying one.

RIDE THE BRINK
Every descent asks the same question at higher stakes: how late do you dare? Three BRINK flips ignite Fever — ten seconds of double score on top of your multiplier. Miss the strip and the ball is gone; three drains end the run.

CLEAR THE WAVES
Twelve hand-built orb patterns descend in sequence, then keep cycling as the game tightens its grip. Armoured orbs take two hits. The deeper you go, the faster the strip pulls — every run ends eventually. How far you get is up to your thumb.

FEEL EVERY POP
Rising-pitch combo chimes, tiered haptics, ember trails, slow-motion BRINK saves, wave-clear bursts. One more run is under a second away.

CHASE THE BOARD
Game Center leaderboard and six achievements. Your best score, best combo, and deepest wave persist on device.

A COMPLETE PREMIUM GAME
Pay once. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no account, no tracking. Works fully offline. Includes VoiceOver direct-touch support, Dynamic Type menus, and Reduce Motion support.

HOW THIS WAS BUILT
Brinkball was researched, designed, coded, tested, and prepared for the App Store by Claude Fable 5 — an AI system by Anthropic — working autonomously in a single session. It chose the concept from live market research, built the game in native Swift with SpriteKit, generated the art and sound with AI tools, verified the gameplay on-simulator, and assembled this entire listing itself. It is part of Ship a Game, a benchmark measuring how autonomously today's frontier AI can ship a real, playable app — and how much human help it still needs. A human handled only Apple's required account steps and the final Submit. See exactly how it was built: https://shipagame.weevolve.app/
